items.title: 54271_Charlie Holmes oral history interview
items.q: After that, I met him, you know, and I found out who he was.

ctx.x: And where did you first run into Jelly Roll Morton? Was it at the Rhythm Club?

No, it was the Bandbox. He come in the Bandbox, and he was playing piano in there. Somebody said to me, 'That's Jelly Roll Morton.' I said, 'Jelly Morton? I never heard of him.' He was sittin' down there playin' the piano, Mister Jelly Lord. Mister Jelly Lord! I don't know what the hell can I say about him. Mister'Jelly Lord, don't come up with that old-time stuff! Heh-heh.
